name: Gravity-Room Freight
description: Rotate an entire chamber and route a physical freight capsule through four ordered airlocks while docking both the capsule and its isolated counterweight.
natural_language: Quarter-turn the room to clear all four numbered airlocks in order and dock both the capsule and the isolated counterweight.

metadata.notes: New Interaction VII–VIII candidate. The browser renders the generated physical state and records only ordinary pointer/keyboard control events; the live server and exported verifier independently replay the mechanic-specific geometry or dynamics.
